DSH Notify
In-page task notifications for DeepSeek Harness: clear status toasts, a collapsible stack, sound, an
d background-tab attention. Live delivery only — notification records are never stored.

Changelog
> DSH Notify is a DeepSeek Harness community plugin. It registers only a settings section and an in-
page overlay; it does not modify DSH source.
When a session really stops, fails, asks a question, or needs approval, a card appears in the top-ri
ght corner of the current page. A green **Task completed** card follows DSH's native `agent/status:
idle` transition — the same state that stops the session-tree spinner — rather than the earlier mome
nt when text first looks complete. Intermediate goal rounds and queued follow-up turns stay quiet. E
verything happens in the page you already have open: there is no service worker, web push, host OS n
otification, or notification history.
## What it does
- **Enhanced or soft toast styling.** The default **Enhanced** style gives each notification a clear
status colour and a short four-second attention bar; the bar is attention only, not a dismissal tim
er. **Soft** is a lower-key alternative. A card remains until you close it, open its session, or com

plete an in-card answer.
- **A collapsible page-local stack.** With **Collapse multiple notification
s** enabled (the default), the second card and onward form a pile: the newest card is fully readable
on top, while earlier cards remain complete underneath and expose equal `18px` lower edges. Pointer
entry or keyboard focus expands the pile. From two cards on, a **Clear all** action sits above the
pile and retires every card on this page at once; clearing stays page-local, so a pending question o
r approval is untouched and still waits in its session. The page keeps up to 50 live cards; pending

actions are prioritised before ordinary cards, then newer cards come first.
- **Direct, traceable na
vigation.** Clicking a card opens its session and the exact originating turn. After the host selects
that session, the selected row is smoothly revealed in the left session tree, even when it lives in
a different off-screen workspace. A card stays put with an explanation if navigation cannot succeed

.
- **Answer in the toast.** A pending question or approval renders the same compatible options as t
he composer. Execution approvals and plan reviews share DSH's amber decision colour; ordinary questi

ons remain blue. In-card and composer answers share the same host interaction.
- **Sound and backgro
und attention.** Built-in WebAudio cues and validated custom uploads play only after a card is admit
ted to an enabled visual Toast queue, including while the page is hidden. One polling batch produces
one cue. A background tab with unseen notifications receives a temporary bell prefix and favicon at

tention marker.

- DeepSeek Harness with a Web profile
- Node.js 24.9.0 or newer for current DSH (the plugin itself d

eclares Node.js 20+)
- Verified DeepSeek Harness version: `0.2.2-rc.1`

Reload the profile or restart DSH only when its plugin host has not hot-reloaded the client. The cli
ent registers `settings.section` and `shell.overlay`; the host mounts through `cordis.patch.yml`.
> **Name note:** the unscoped npm name `dsh-notify` belongs to another author. Install this plugin a
s **`@idoall/dsh-notify`**. Its internal Cordis name, mount id, and `/plugins/dsh-notify/*` routes r
tify`**. Its internal Cordis name, mount id, and `/plugins/dsh-notify/*` routes remain `dsh-notify`.
## Settings
**Settings → Notifications** provides a compact preview-first control surface:
| Setting | Default | What it does |
| Toast position | conversation top-right | Anchors the overlay to the chat column and follows sideb

ar layout changes. |

## Compatibility
Current release: plugin **`0.4.13`** is verified against DeepSeek Harness **`0.2.2-rc.1`**.
| Plugin | Verified DeepSeek Harness | What that version is |
| **`0.4.13`** | `0.2.2-rc.1` | Declares the new DSH RC compatible, preserves existing support, and
updates bilingual release information and the current DSH Node.js requirement. No notification sourc

e changes. |
| `0.4.12` | `0.2.2-alpha.3` | Fixes Client entry lifecycle handling (constructor detec
tion and cleanup return), declares the current DSH alpha compatible, synchronizes lockfile DSH peer
ranges, updates locked Zod, and adds bilingual release checks. Notification logic is unchanged; see

the release notes for verification limits. |
| `0.4.11` | `0.2.2-alpha.2` | Declares DSH `0.2.2-alph
a.2` compatible — one `dshReleases` line, since `>=0.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0` already admitted it. No source
change: `dsh-client-ui-renderer`, which owns the whole `slots` service, is byte-identical, as are `
dsh-client-ui-settings`, `dsh-jobs`, `dsh-client-ui-slots`, `dsh-tool-workflow` and `dsh-client-conn
ection`'s host half. The six packages that did change are all additive and off the notification call
path — a second `resource` route style in `dsh-host-webserver` (its `register(route)` body and the
`{kind,path,handler}` dispatch are unchanged), one new `whenAccess()` in `dsh-client-ui-session`, si
x locale dictionaries in `dsh-client-ui-layout`, `require.asset` plus the `/plugins/<pkg>/assets` ro
ute in `dsh-client-modules`, a settings-panel grid restyle in `dsh-client-ui-settings-general` (the

seat's `{close}` props are unchanged), and one browser-transport type in `dsh-client-connection` |
|
`0.4.10` | `0.2.1-rc.4` | Declares DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` compatible — one `dshReleases` line, since `>=0
.1.7-rc.1 <0.3.0` already admitted it. No source change: of the packages it binds, every one is byte
-identical across `0.2.1-rc.3` → `0.2.1-rc.4` except `dsh-client-ui-settings-general`, whose client

only substitutes the host version string it displays |
